svg.aria-label: Any tree: Folders, budgets, categories: anything with children and a value.; Hover and click: The middle names the piece under the pointer; a click or tap selects it.; VoiceOver: Every piece is a button with its label and detail.; Light and dark: System colors per branch, outer rings fainter, on macOS and iOS.; Laid out once: The rings are computed when the tree changes, never on a mouse move.; No dependencies: SwiftUI only, Swift 6 with strict concurrency.
